series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

label.text: Annual net target accounting emissions in kt CO2e

progress.text:
In 2022, net target accounting emissions were 15.6 per cent below total gross emissions in the base year (2005).
New Zealand’s net target accounting emissions in 2021 and 2022 were 75,742 kt CO2e and 73,116 kt CO2e. This leaves an emissions budget of 430,143 kt CO2e for the remaining budget period until 2030.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is New Zealand’s second Nationally Determined Contribution, filed 2025-01-31. 78 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (32). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 87.3 MtCO₂e, DS-35 81.9 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 66.2 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: reduce GHG emissions to 30% below 2005 levels by 2030 It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.72°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.22°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
